theorems.name: StoreM4.PinSafety.active_pin_protects_root
theorems.type: ∀ (t : StoreM4.PinSafety.PinTable) (e : StoreM4.PinSafety.PinEntry), e ∈ t → e.protectsRoot → StoreM4.PinSafety.PinTable.reachableRoot t e.root

theorems.name: StoreM4.PinSafety.acquire_protects_new_and_existing_roots
theorems.type: ∀ (t : StoreM4.PinSafety.PinTable) (id root r : Nat) (parent : Option Nat), (r = root ∨ StoreM4.PinSafety.PinTable.reachableRoot t r) → StoreM4.PinSafety.PinTable.reachableRoot (StoreM4.PinSafety.PinTable.acquire t id root parent) r

theorems.name: StoreM4.PinSafety.expireStep_retains_protection_while_held
theorems.type: ∀ (e : StoreM4.PinSafety.PinEntry), e.protectsRoot → (e.activeReaderLoans > 0 ∨ e.liveChildPins > 0) → e.expireStep.protectsRoot

theorems.name: StoreM4.PinSafety.expireById_preserves_held_reachability
theorems.type: ∀ (t : StoreM4.PinSafety.PinTable) (targetId : Nat) (e : StoreM4.PinSafety.PinEntry), e ∈ t → e.protectsRoot → (e.id = targetId → e.activeReaderLoans > 0 ∨ e.liveChildPins > 0) → StoreM4.PinSafety.PinTable.reachableRoot (StoreM4.PinSafety.PinTable.expireById t targetId) e.root

theorems.name: StoreM4.PinSafety.reclaim_disjoint_preserves_active_pins
theorems.type: ∀ (t : StoreM4.PinSafety.PinTable) (reclaimSet : Nat → Prop) (e : StoreM4.PinSafety.PinEntry), (∀ r, reclaimSet r → ¬ StoreM4.PinSafety.PinTable.reachableRoot t r) → e ∈ t → e.protectsRoot → ¬ reclaimSet e.root

theorems.name: StoreM4.GCPinSafety.StoreGCPinSafety
theorems.type: ∀ (liveRoots : Nat → Prop) (t : StoreM4.PinSafety.PinTable) (reclaimSet : Nat → Prop), StoreM4.GCPinSafety.Reachable t → (∀ r, reclaimSet r → ¬ StoreM4.GCPinSafety.projectedReach liveRoots t r) → ∀ r, StoreM4.GCPinSafety.fullReach liveRoots t r → ¬ reclaimSet r

theorems.name: StoreM4.GCPinSafety.LeaseExpiryNoReaderLoss
theorems.type: ∀ (t t' : StoreM4.PinSafety.PinTable) (id : Nat), StoreM4.GCPinSafety.Reachable t → StoreM4.GCPinSafety.leaseExpire t id = some t' → (∀ e ∈ t, e.protectsRoot → (e.activeReaderLoans > 0 ∨ StoreM4.GCPinSafety.childCount t e.id > 0) → ∃ e' ∈ t', e'.id = e.id ∧ e'.root = e.root ∧ e'.protectsRoot) ∧ (∀ e' ∈ t', e'.id = id → e'.state = StoreM4.PinSafety.LeaseState.expired → e'.activeReaderLoans = 0 ∧ e'.liveChildPins = 0 ∧ StoreM4.GCPinSafety.childCount t' id = 0) ∧ (∀ e' ∈ t', e'.id = id → e'.state ≠ StoreM4.PinSafety.LeaseState.active → StoreM4.GCPinSafety.loanAcquire t' id = none) ∧ (∀ e' ∈ t', e'.protectsRoot → ∀ a, StoreM4.GCPinSafety.OverlayAncestor t' e' a → a ∈ t' ∧ a.protectsRoot)

theorems.name: StoreM4.GCPinSafety.Reachable.wf
theorems.type: ∀ {t : StoreM4.PinSafety.PinTable}, StoreM4.GCPinSafety.Reachable t → StoreM4.GCPinSafety.WellFormed t

theorems.name: StoreM4.GCPinSafety.expire_completes_when_drained
theorems.type: ∀ (t : StoreM4.PinSafety.PinTable) (e : StoreM4.PinSafety.PinEntry), StoreM4.GCPinSafety.Reachable t → e ∈ t → e.state = StoreM4.PinSafety.LeaseState.expiring → e.activeReaderLoans = 0 → e.liveChildPins = 0 → ∃ t', StoreM4.GCPinSafety.leaseExpire t e.id = some t' ∧ ∀ e' ∈ t', e'.id = e.id → e'.state = StoreM4.PinSafety.LeaseState.expired

theorems.name: StoreM4.ChunkedCoverage.fixed_partition_covers_each_slot_once
theorems.type: ∀ (c total slot : Nat), 0 < c → slot < total → (∃ r ∈ StoreM4.ChunkedCoverage.fixedPartition c total, r.contains slot) ∧ (∀ k₁ k₂, (StoreM4.ChunkedCoverage.fixedChunk c total k₁).contains slot → (StoreM4.ChunkedCoverage.fixedChunk c total k₂).contains slot → k₁ = k₂)

theorems.name: StoreM4.ChunkedCoverage.consolidate_preserves_canonical
theorems.type: ∀ {V : Type} (p : StoreM4.ChunkedCoverage.PhysicalChunk V) (newLocator : Nat), StoreM4.ChunkedCoverage.canonical (StoreM4.ChunkedCoverage.consolidate p newLocator) = StoreM4.ChunkedCoverage.canonical p

theorems.name: StoreM4.ChunkedCoverage.semantic_commitment_consolidation_invariant
theorems.type: ∀ {V α : Type} (hash : List (Nat × List V) → α) (p : StoreM4.ChunkedCoverage.PhysicalChunk V) (newLocator : Nat), hash (StoreM4.ChunkedCoverage.canonical (StoreM4.ChunkedCoverage.consolidate p newLocator)) = hash (StoreM4.ChunkedCoverage.canonical p)

theorems.name: StoreM4.ChunkedCoverage.semantic_root_consolidation_invariant
theorems.type: ∀ {V α β : Type} (hash : List (Nat × List V) → α) (root : List α → β) (chunks : List (StoreM4.ChunkedCoverage.PhysicalChunk V)) (newLocator : StoreM4.ChunkedCoverage.PhysicalChunk V → Nat), root ((chunks.map fun p => StoreM4.ChunkedCoverage.consolidate p (newLocator p)).map (hash ∘ StoreM4.ChunkedCoverage.canonical)) = root (chunks.map (hash ∘ StoreM4.ChunkedCoverage.canonical))

theorems.name: StoreM4.ChunkedCoverage.pruned_scan_agrees_with_full_scan
theorems.type: ∀ {R K : Type} [inst : DecidableEq K] (keys : R → List K) (k : K) (chunks : List (StoreM4.ChunkedCoverage.SummarizedChunk R K)), (∀ ch ∈ chunks, ch.summary = StoreM4.ChunkedCoverage.derive keys ch.records) → StoreM4.ChunkedCoverage.prunedScan keys k chunks = StoreM4.ChunkedCoverage.fullScan keys k chunks

theorems.name: StoreM4.ChunkedCoverage.omitted_key_violates_derivation
theorems.type: ∀ {R K : Type} (keys : R → List K) (k : K) (ch : StoreM4.ChunkedCoverage.SummarizedChunk R K), (∃ r ∈ ch.records, k ∈ keys r) → k ∉ ch.summary → ch.summary ≠ StoreM4.ChunkedCoverage.derive keys ch.records

theorems.name: StoreM4.ChunkedCoverage.omitted_key_breaks_pruned_scan
theorems.type: ∀ {R K : Type} [inst : DecidableEq K] (keys : R → List K) (k : K) (ch : StoreM4.ChunkedCoverage.SummarizedChunk R K), (∃ r ∈ ch.records, k ∈ keys r) → k ∉ ch.summary → StoreM4.ChunkedCoverage.prunedScan keys k [ch] ≠ StoreM4.ChunkedCoverage.fullScan keys k [ch]

theorems.name: StoreM4.ChunkedCoverage.ChunkedCoverageAndSummarySound
theorems.type: (∀ c total slot, 0 < c → slot < total → (∃ r ∈ StoreM4.ChunkedCoverage.fixedPartition c total, r.contains slot) ∧ (∀ k₁ k₂, (StoreM4.ChunkedCoverage.fixedChunk c total k₁).contains slot → (StoreM4.ChunkedCoverage.fixedChunk c total k₂).contains slot → k₁ = k₂)) ∧ (∀ (V α : Type) (hash : List (Nat × List V) → α) (p : StoreM4.ChunkedCoverage.PhysicalChunk V) (newLocator : Nat), hash (StoreM4.ChunkedCoverage.canonical (StoreM4.ChunkedCoverage.consolidate p newLocator)) = hash (StoreM4.ChunkedCoverage.canonical p)) ∧ (∀ (R K : Type) [DecidableEq K] (keys : R → List K) (k : K) (chunks : List (StoreM4.ChunkedCoverage.SummarizedChunk R K)), (∀ ch ∈ chunks, ch.summary = StoreM4.ChunkedCoverage.derive keys ch.records) → StoreM4.ChunkedCoverage.prunedScan keys k chunks = StoreM4.ChunkedCoverage.fullScan keys k chunks)

theorems.name: StoreM4.ExtentGenerationSafety.AddressReuseGenerationAndWriteFenceSound
theorems.type: ∀ s : StoreM4.ExtentGenerationSafety.Sys, StoreM4.ExtentGenerationSafety.Reachable s → (∀ w ∈ s.inflight, ¬ w.gen.lt s.floorGen ∧ ∀ e ∈ s.seen, e.range.overlaps w.range → ¬ w.gen.lt e.gen) ∧ (∀ f ∈ s.frames, ¬ f.gen.lt s.floorGen ∧ ∀ e ∈ s.seen, e.range.overlaps f.range → ¬ f.gen.lt e.gen) ∧ (∀ (r : StoreM4.ExtentGenerationSafety.Range), ∀ h ∈ s.history, h.lt s.nextGen ∧ ¬ StoreM4.ExtentGenerationSafety.lookupMatches ⟨r, s.nextGen⟩ r h)

theorems.name: StoreM4.ExtentGenerationSafety.post_crash_frame_never_rewinds_below_history
theorems.type: ∀ {s : StoreM4.ExtentGenerationSafety.Sys}, StoreM4.ExtentGenerationSafety.Reachable s → ∀ (i : StoreM4.ExtentGenerationSafety.Ident), StoreM4.ExtentGenerationSafety.current { s with seen := [], inflight := [], frames := [], floorGen := ⟨s.rootGen, s.walSeq⟩ } i → ∀ g ∈ s.history, ¬ i.gen.lt g

theorems.name: StoreM4.ExtentGenerationSafety.Reachable.inv
theorems.type: ∀ {s : StoreM4.ExtentGenerationSafety.Sys}, StoreM4.ExtentGenerationSafety.Reachable s → StoreM4.ExtentGenerationSafety.Inv s

theorems.name: StoreM4.ExtentGenerationSafety.guard_generation_holds
theorems.type: ∀ {s : StoreM4.ExtentGenerationSafety.Sys}, StoreM4.ExtentGenerationSafety.Reachable s → ∀ (r : StoreM4.ExtentGenerationSafety.Range), ∀ e ∈ s.seen, e.range.overlaps r → e.gen.lt s.nextGen

theorems.name: StoreM4.ExtentGenerationSafety.M10_without_drain_paused_writeback_clobbers
theorems.type: StoreM4.ExtentGenerationSafety.Inv StoreM4.ExtentGenerationSafety.unfencedAdmitWitness ∧ ∃ w ∈ (StoreM4.ExtentGenerationSafety.unfencedAdmitWitness.admitRange ⟨1, 4, 2⟩).inflight, ¬ StoreM4.ExtentGenerationSafety.current (StoreM4.ExtentGenerationSafety.unfencedAdmitWitness.admitRange ⟨1, 4, 2⟩) w

theorems.name: StoreM4.ExtentGenerationSafety.M10_without_cancel_epoch_advance_aliases
theorems.type: let first := StoreM4.ExtentGenerationSafety.init.admitNoAdvance ⟨1, 0, 8⟩; let reopened : StoreM4.ExtentGenerationSafety.Sys := { first with seen := [], inflight := [], frames := [] }; let reused := reopened.admitNoAdvance ⟨1, 0, 8⟩; reused.rootGen = StoreM4.ExtentGenerationSafety.init.rootGen ∧ ∃ stale ∈ first.history, ∃ live ∈ reused.seen, StoreM4.ExtentGenerationSafety.lookupMatches live ⟨1, 0, 8⟩ stale
